# UTF-8 C1 controls inside a control string. xterm ends the string on any of
# them, ST (U+009C) and CSI (U+009B) included. herdr 0.9.1 ignores UTF-8 C1
# controls, so it may keep hiding. Sightline keeps hiding too, and flags what
# it shows meanwhile, so nothing either terminal hides reaches a message
# unflagged. Found by FuzzInjection.
# hidden: HIDDEN
# caught: Error: after
@ feed
A\eXHIDDEN sos\u009cHIDDEN after a C1 ST Error: x\e\\B
A\e]0;HIDDEN\u009bmHIDDEN after a C1 CSI Error: y\aB
A\ePHIDDEN\u0085HIDDEN after a NEL Error: z\e\\B
A\u009dHIDDEN\u009cHIDDEN c1 st after a c1 osc
HIDDEN Error: still hidden on the next line\aB
@ wait 2s
@ feed
Error: after
